name: making-charge-calculator
description: Jewellery making-charge calculator (static app in docs/, served by GitHub Pages). Dependencies here are for local testing only.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules && npm run test:components && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-mc --config firebase/firebase.json "node --test tests/rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:components: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-mc --config firebase/firebase.json "node tests/components.mjs"
scripts.test:e2e: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-mc --config firebase/firebase.json "node tests/e2e.mjs"
